extracted.intended_audience: readers of Popular Science Monthly; educated lay readers and scientists interested in biology, protoplasm, and origins-of-life questions
extracted.subtask_description: Principles and methodological criteria for assessing theories about the physical/chemical basis and origin of life (protoplasm, contractility, organic synthesis). Emphasizes observational verification, chemical testability, and mechanistic explanation over metaphysical conjecture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid fixed ideas; follow evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: The great object of scientific investigation is to run counter to that tendency [of the human mind] to stick in a groove.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not let canons or entrenched opinions (e.g., the previous dismissal of fossil man) prevent recognition of plain evidence. Be prepared to overturn long-held beliefs in light of accumulated evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Require step-by-step verification
rubrics_metrics.description: The science of organization maintains not on mere general grounds or formal conclusions drawn from assumed premises, but it is ready to prove it step by step by actual verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims about organization or origin must be supported by sequential, empirical verification rather than broad metaphysical assertions or purely formal argument.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclude unscientific conjecture; rely on observable phenomena
rubrics_metrics.description: No unscientific conjecture has been allowed to enter into the above conception... We see the disintegrated protoplasm. We see it combine with substances drifted to it by the medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Base theories on directly observable, repeatable phenomena (e.g., visible products of decomposition, globules, reintegration events) rather than speculative, unverified ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explain biological properties by chemical/physical mechanisms where possible
rubrics_metrics.description: The chief vital manifestation of protoplasm, its contractility, can no longer startle us, for we know exactly how it is produced by well-known chemical and physical means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduce ostensible 'vital' properties to known chemical/physical processes when empirical evidence allows; avoid invoking special vital forces without necessity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Frame origin-of-life questions as specific chemical problems
rubrics_metrics.description: This question is not at all one of vitality, but merely one of specific chemistry. Their verification would constitute not a biological but a purely chemical task.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating claims about the origin of organic compounds or life, demand formulation in terms of specific, testable chemical processes amenable to chemical experimentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use experimental chemical synthesis as evidential support
rubrics_metrics.description: Organic substances can also be made to originate in the same manner; that from inorganic material Woehler produced urea, Strecker taurin, Kolbe acetic acid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give weight to laboratory syntheses showing inorganic→organic transformations as direct empirical evidence relevant to origin theories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish production (origin) from reproduction (growth/propagation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Growth... and propagation... do not belong to the domain of production, but entirely to that of reproduction. Propagation multiplies, growth reconstructs, organic results previously achieved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not conflate explanations of the origin (production) of living substance with processes of growth and reproduction; treat them as separate domains when judging arguments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Variations must be causally explained; reject unsupported spontaneous variation
rubrics_metrics.description: Variations in the molecular constitution of the protoplasm can only be effected either by the dynamical influences of the medium, or by the restitutive material of the medium. Spontaneous variations... would be... an inadmissible supposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require concrete causal mechanisms (external dynamical influences or properties of restitutive material) to account for molecular changes; treat unsupported internal spontaneous variation skeptically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for chemical affinities and complementarity in organizational claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Reintegration of the living substance... is the work of preestablished chemical affinities, and it requires extraneous matter of a specific kind to enable this restitution to take place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explanations of reintegration/organization must specify the complementary chemical partners and affinities that enable restoration of protoplasm; include observational examples of disintegrated protoplasm combining with medium-supplied substances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Favor gradual, cumulative development via iterative functional processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Development can make its entry... the infinitely toilsome elaboration of molecular complexity by means of ever-reiterated functional disintegration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate evolutionary/developmental accounts for plausibility in terms of very small, cumulative molecular changes accumulated over many cycles and geological time rather than abrupt leaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use quantitative, measurable frameworks (expansion/contraction) in explanations
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparative expansion and contraction are, and must be, the subject-matter of all quantitative science. All intensities are made quantitatively scientific by being 'converted' into modes of space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formulate and assess hypotheses in terms of measurable changes (e.g., spatial expansion/contraction) that allow quantitative comparison and empirical testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ground metaphysical or teleological claims in chemical evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: The contending claims of naturalism and supernaturalism... turn actually, in the field of science, upon the paltry issue of the synthesis of ternary carbon compounds, whether this be chemically or whether it be superchemically effected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid resolving metaphysical disputes without recourse to the chemical facts that bear on them; prefer naturalistic chemical explanations unless and until chemical evidence necessitates otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize role of use/disuse in functional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Previous functional exercise of an organ fits the same all the better for further functional performances. Use develops functional structure; disuse involves its atrophy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When judging explanations of organ development or functional change, consider empirical evidence that repeated functional activity shapes structure (and disuse leads to atrophy) as part of the causal story.
